'''''Griphon''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with its sister ship, [[Manticore (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|''Manticore'']], the ''Griphon'' was assigned to escort the POW-carrying [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[VTR-LX]]'' to penal station [[Bundil II]]. However, both shuttles were destroyed in a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rescue at Bundil II|rescue operation]] that also destroyed ''VTR-LX''.
